Hi Raj / Emma — thanks, good questions. Answers inline and a refined commercial proposal below.

- SOC2 artifact: The SOC2 summary is what we commonly share early in the process. For commit-level discounts we require either the SOC2 Type II report or an SOC2 bridge letter / recent auditor attestation. If procurement needs the full report we can coordinate an NDA / restricted disclosure workflow so your legal team can review.

- Credits vs discounts: The per-token bands I shared are token-unit discounts (net of credits). We can discuss limited onboarding credits separately (typ. $5k–$25k depending on term).

- Billing flow: You can start at baseline monthly invoicing. Discounted committed pricing is effective once we have both: (1) signed DPA and (2) SOC2 evidence (report or bridge letter). We offer a retroactive credit for overpayments up to 60 days after evidence is provided (i.e., once gating items are satisfied we reconcile invoices).

Refined pricing proposal (for discussion):
- Option A (12mo term, standard): 100M tokens / mo committed -> $0.00070 / token (20% off baseline) + $10k onboarding credit
- Option B (12mo term, expansion-friendly): 100M tokens / mo committed -> $0.00068 / token (22% off baseline) if Quantifly agrees to a 12-mo term and commit is invoiced annually (prepay)
- Option C (flex start): Start monthly @ baseline, convert to Option A once DPA + SOC2 evidence delivered; retro-credit up to 60 days

If you need a specific clause we can add: "Discount is contingent on execution of DPA and Redwood receiving SOC2 Type II report or auditor attestation; in the event of delayed delivery, discounts are applied retroactively for up to 60 days of prior invoices."

If that looks reasonable, I'll draft a short term sheet and loop our legal for a DPA draft.

Best,
Laura
